about: Counts down or up in tabular figures, with buttons that start, pause, resume and reset the count. The count is a `timer` region named by the time in words.

effect.about: `glow` puts a halo around each tile. `pulse` animates the halo and stops for a reader who asked for less motion.
effect.title: Effects

launch.about: The countdown shows twelve days to a launch in tiles of the subtle look, with a unit letter after each part. The time left is stated in days, hours, minutes and seconds and parsed with `Timer.parse`.
launch.title: Countdown in days

palette.about: The palette colors the tiles, shown here in the subtle look.
palette.title: Palettes

pomodoro.about: The timer runs a 25-minute focus and a 5-minute break. `onTick` feeds the progress bar, and `onComplete` switches to the other phase, which restarts the timer at its new `startMs`. Restart shows in every state.
pomodoro.title: Pomodoro

resend.about: A code can be sent again after 30 seconds. `onComplete` enables the button, and a press starts the next wait.
resend.title: Resend a code

size.about: The count reads the heading scale: 18, 22.8 and 32.4px. The buttons take the timer's size.
size.title: Sizes

stopwatch.about: The stopwatch counts up in milliseconds. It ticks every 10ms. A press on Start moves focus to Pause, because the machine hides the pressed button.
stopwatch.title: Stopwatch

title: Timer

variant.about: Each part is bare, or set in a tile of a flat look. The figures are tabular, so the count keeps its width while it ticks.
variant.title: Looks
